title: DynamicAppSchema
description: Meta-schema describing an Angular application as data, so it can be rendered at runtime by @elyvion/shared-lib's dynamic-render module instead of being compiled per customer.

id.description: Application id, matches the applicationId passed into DynamicAppService.loadApplication().

version.description: Schema/application version, e.g. for cache-busting or migration logic.

rootComponentId.description: Id of the node in `components` to start rendering from.

components.description: Flat list of every component, HTML element, or text node in the application. Hierarchy is expressed via each node's `children` (a list of ids), not by nesting objects.

id.description: Unique id of this component instance within the schema.

type.description: Node kind. Defaults to component when name is set, element when element is set, and text otherwise.

name.description: Logical Angular component type name, resolved at runtime against the host app's component registry and lazily loaded (code-split) on first use.

type.description: Node kind. Defaults to component when name is set, element when element is set, otherwise text.

element.description: HTML tag name for an element node.

text.description: Text content for a text node.

position.description: Absolute coordinates within the rendered application root and its stacking/order.

attributes.description: Attributes for this instance. Element attributes are set on native HTML elements; component attributes become Angular @Inputs(), except `style` and `class`, which are applied to the host element.

style.description: CSS property name → value map (e.g. SCSS-computed values), applied directly to the rendered component's host element.

children.description: Ids of this node's children, rendered in order inside its HTML element or Angular component host.
